Development evidence available before this fit: shared_boundary_response: MAE 7.31915, worst group 15.7251.

The shared first-order response improves over polynomial extrapolation. Test the full Fickian slab breakthrough shape, allowing a boundary-onset lag rather than assuming first-order arrival. The normalized lag is explicit; model failure is not evidence against diffusion generally.
